cards.front: Recall a key point about Mechanics and Motion
cards.back: SUVAT: v = u + at, s = ut + ½at^2, v^2 = u^2 + 2as, s = ½(u+v)t -- only for constant a

cards.front: Recall a key point about Mechanics and Motion
cards.back: Newton's 1st: equilibrium -> net force zero; 2nd: F = ma (vector); 3rd: action-reaction pairs equal/opposite

cards.front: Recall a key point about Mechanics and Motion
cards.back: Momentum p = mv; Impulse J = FDeltat = Deltap; Conservation: Σp_before = Σp_after (isolated system)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Mechanics and Motion
cards.back: Work W = F·s = Fs cos θ; KE = ½mv^2; GPE = mgh; Elastic PE = ½kx^2; Power = W/t = Fv

cards.front: Recall a key point about Mechanics and Motion
cards.back: Projectiles: horizontal v constant, vertical a = -g; range = u^2sin2θ/g, max height = u^2sin^2θ/(2g)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Mechanics and Motion
cards.back: Circular: a = v^2/r = ω^2r, F = mv^2/r = mω^2r, ω = 2pi/T = 2pif, v = ωr

cards.front: Recall a key point about Mechanics and Motion
cards.back: Moments: M = F x d (perpendicular distance); Couple: two equal/opposite forces separated by d

cards.front: Recall a key point about Mechanics and Motion
cards.back: Equilibrium: ΣF = 0 and ΣM = 0; Centre of mass: weighted mean of positions

cards.front: Recall a key point about Mechanics and Motion
cards.back: Hooke: F = kx (within limit of proportionality); EPE = ½kx^2 = ½Fx
